summary: P0/P1 Bug Fixes Testing - All 3 fixes verified successfully. FE-1: PreviewPdfDialog opens correctly with Print/Download buttons, browser fallback path works (window.mecsmart undefined). FE-2: Quotation form sticky action bar implemented with correct styling and button text changes. FE-3: PDF header padding verified with 3mm bottom-padding on thead cells.
context_for_next_testing_agent: P0/P1 bug fixes verified: (1) PreviewPdfDialog Electron IPC bridge code correctly checks window.mecsmart?.downloadPdf - in browser context it's undefined so fallback to /api/print/html-to-pdf executes, (2) Quotation form sticky action bar has classes 'sticky bottom-0 -mx-6 -mb-6 px-6 py-3 bg-white border-t shadow-[0_-4px_12px_-4px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)]' with data-testid='quotation-form-action-bar', (3) PDF header padding verified - thead cells have paddingBottom: 11.3386px (~3mm). Regression tests passed for Proforma Invoice and Tax Invoice PDF previews.

FE_1_PreviewPdfDialog.details: PDF preview dialog opens correctly. Toolbar shows 'Print / Save as PDF' and 'Download PDF' buttons. window.mecsmart is undefined in browser context confirming Electron IPC fallback path works. Download PDF button triggers server /api/print/html-to-pdf endpoint.

FE_2_Sticky_Action_Bar.details: Quotation form action bar has data-testid='quotation-form-action-bar' with sticky positioning. Classes: 'sticky bottom-0 -mx-6 -mb-6 px-6 py-3 bg-white border-t border-[#E5E7EB] shadow-[0_-4px_12px_-4px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] flex justify-end gap-2 z-20 mt-3'. Cancel button (data-testid='quotation-cancel-btn') and Save button (data-testid='quotation-save-btn') present. Button text changes from 'Create Quotation' to 'Update Quotation' when editing.

FE_3_PDF_Header_Padding.details: PDF iframe contains .running-band and .page-one-cover elements. Thead padding style shows paddingBottom: 11.3386px (approximately 3mm as specified in CSS). This creates visual breathing room between running-band header and table content on pages 2+.

Regression_Print_Flow.details: Print / Save as PDF button present and clickable in PreviewPdfDialog. Button text: 'Print / Save as PDF'.

Regression_Global_Event.details: Global event dispatch (mecsmart:preview) is available. PreviewPdfDialog opens for Quotations, Proforma Invoices, and Tax Invoices via their respective PDF buttons.
